highlights.title: Read Yomitomo in Japanese
highlights.description: Readers who prefer Japanese can switch to 日本語 in Settings. The app, assistant personas, website help, and release notes change together.

highlights.title: Leave update downloads in the background
highlights.description: Downloads show transferred size, total size, and live speed. Close the dialog and work continues; the header entry can reopen progress at any time.

highlights.title: Library failures keep your place
highlights.description: When an import, delete, search, or collection switch fails, existing articles and the dialog you were using stay in place so you can continue after recovery.

highlights.title: Annotations and conversations save reliably
highlights.description: Nested replies, comment edits, distillation commits, and reading progress now recover correctly from concurrent or failed saves instead of being replaced by stale content.

highlights.title: Long reading sessions stay steady
highlights.description: Reader updates no longer trigger themselves repeatedly, Library queries do less duplicate work, and assistant avatars using inline images render correctly.
